decisions.reason: The Topic-to-tema label clarification does not change the required behavior for inserting a row after that field.
This Requirement governs how fillable fields remain visually identifiable, not the Board Meeting Topic field's displayed label.
Renaming or translating the Topic label does not alter multiline-entry behavior.
The label clarification is unrelated to Tab-driven list-level transitions and hierarchy.
The Board Meeting Topic label does not affect bullet dimensions, alignment, scaling, or appearance.
The source only clarifies a Board Meeting field label and does not change placeholder clear-on-activation behavior.
The source concerns the visible Board Meeting Topic heading used for alignment, not an interactive-field help label or hover prompt.
The Topic-to-tema clarification does not affect the approved theme-color choices.
Board Meeting field-label terminology does not change numbered-list alignment behavior.
The source does not change text wrapping, column positioning, or overflow constraints.
The field-label clarification has no effect on hard-return spacing in continuous text.
Clarifying that Topic corresponds to tema does not alter date-selector behavior, format, or scope.
